note: WAEC Marketing round 5 (Round 25 top-up): micro-environment, economic environment, legal-political force, demographic change; psychographic and behavioural segmentation, mass vs niche marketing; product life cycle and its stages, trademark, packaging non-functions, product modification; cost-plus, skimming, penetration and N999 psychological pricing; primary vs secondary data, problem definition first, probability sampling; publicity, PR vs advertising, trade fairs, personal selling for machinery; zero-level channel, channel conflict, online direct channel, search ads, click-through rate; standardisation, adaptation, dumping; prospecting, closing, follow-up. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Marketing (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
